newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers dip $1, buyers postpone.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers dip $1, buyers postpone.

text.p: Rotterdam bunkers dipped by $1 a tonne on Monday and most buyers postponed, with increasing numbers believing prices would come off this week, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were quoted in the range $89/$90 as barges dipped to around $88 fob Rotterdam, albeit in a thinly traded market.
Some suppliers said product remained short in the ARA area. Brokers were more inclined to talk of surpluses.
"They're up to their ears in oil in ARA. Prices will have to fall this week," one broker said.
Total ARA trading volume reached about 10,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices fell by $1 in response to ARA weakness. Demand was again poor.
Mediterranean and Middle East bunkers were broadly steady with a low level of enquiries.
